role: Original campaign illustration; native layouts retain actual application screenshots and exact typography.
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: reusable original campaign illustration for EcoPrompt, a browser extension that helps people be mindful of AI text usage.
Primary request: Create a premium, minimal, sculptural illustration of ONE abstract chat bubble whose upper-right corner folds into a botanical leaf. The speech bubble and leaf are a single unified object, expressing the connection between AI conversations and environmental awareness. No other props.
Scene/backdrop: seamless warm pale ivory #f7f8f2 studio background, extremely subtle natural paper grain.
Subject: a single deep forest green #345a3c folded-paper/ceramic chat-bubble-and-leaf sculpture, a small soft sage #bed29a folded inner surface. Clear recognizable silhouette, no holes that look like eyes, no mascot face. A sculptural rounded square with a short speech tail and one graceful leaf emerging from the folded upper-right corner. Leaf has one tasteful central vein.
Style/medium: high-end editorial 3D still life, matte paper/unglazed ceramic material, sophisticated and tactile, clean geometric curves, restrained botanical detail.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 composition, sculpture fully visible in the RIGHT HALF of the image, approximately 65% image height, generous clean empty space to the LEFT for later native typography, generous margins all around, no crop. Camera almost frontal, slight top view.
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, gentle grounding shadow, calm and optimistic, no glow.
Constraints: absolutely no text, no letters, no numerals, no UI, no charts, no logo text, no watermark, no people, no globe, no recycling arrows, no electricity bolts, no water droplets, no claims of carbon savings. This is an illustration, not a screenshot. Do not incorporate product UI. Output opaque background.
